lines.zh: 海鹦在岩石上小步快走
lines.en: The puffin bustles along the rock in short steps.

lines.zh: 橙色的喙在灰岩上很扎眼
lines.en: Its orange bill stands out on grey stone.

lines.zh: 它摇摇摆摆地走过石台
lines.en: It waddles across the ledge.
Its feet slip a little on the ice.
It goes to the cliff edge and peers down.
It turns back, carefully.
Wings half open for balance.

lines.zh: 它绕过一块结冰的石头
lines.en: It skirts a frozen stone.
It works along a crack in the rock.
It stops where the wind is cut.

lines.zh: 它把脚抬得很高再落下
lines.en: It lifts each foot high before setting it down.
It squeezes between two of its kind.

lines.zh: 它拖着圆身子往坡上爬
lines.en: Its round body hauls up the slope.
It shakes the water off.
It crosses the edge of the ice.
It looks back at the sea.
The puffin stands with wings held in.

lines.zh: 它把喙在岩石上蹭了蹭
lines.en: It rubs its bill on the rock.
Its feet are bright.

lines.zh: 冷风里它把羽毛蓬起来
lines.en: It fluffs its feathers against the cold.

lines.zh: 它把喙在岩石上蹭了蹭。
lines.en: It rubs its beak on the rock.

lines.zh: 它把一只脚缩进腹羽里
lines.en: It tucks a foot into its belly feathers.
It cocks its head at the frozen water.
Fine grooves mark its bill.
It flicks its short tail.
Then it leans forward.
And slowly straightens.

lines.zh: 风把它的胸羽吹得贴在身上
lines.en: Wind flattens its breast feathers.
It turns its body around.
It seems to be waiting for a calmer sea.
The puffin looks up at you.
Its dark eye does not move.

lines.zh: 我抬起橙色的喙，朝你点了点。
lines.en: I lift my orange beak and nod at you.
It edges half a step aside.
It tilts its head at your boots.
It does not flee, only keeps care.
It puffs its chest out.
It takes two steps your way.
It stops by your feet.
Then turns back to the sea.
The puffin flutters away.
Its round body rolls once.
A few feathers are out of place.
It lands and pants quickly.

lines.zh: 它侧着身，一只翅膀垂着
lines.en: It stands crooked, one wing low.
It retreats toward the crevice.
It gives one short call.
It tucks its bill to its chest.
It shakes and steadies again.
It still looks toward the sea.

lines.zh: 海鹦朝你手上的鱼来了
lines.en: The puffin comes for the fish.
It grabs the fish and shakes it twice.
It swallows the fish head first.
Its throat bulges.
It looks up for a second.
It holds several fish crosswise in its bill.

lines.zh: 它不太想让别的鸟靠近
lines.en: It does not want other birds near.
It turns to shield the food.
Having eaten, it shakes itself.
It heads for the cliff as if to leave.

lines.zh: 海鹦被撞得踉跄了一下
lines.en: The puffin stumbles at the knock.

lines.zh: 它圆身子晃了晃又稳住
lines.en: Its round body rocks and steadies.
It steps aside, courteous.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀扫过你的脚踝
lines.en: A wing brushes your ankle.
It looks up to see who bumped it.
It backs against a stone.

lines.zh: 它的脚在湿岩上滑了一下
lines.en: A foot slips on the wet rock.
It rights itself and shakes.
It walks back to its spot.
As if nothing had happened.

lines.zh: 两只海鹦把喙碰在一起
lines.en: Two puffins touch bills.

lines.zh: 我把颈羽贴过去，替它理顺。
lines.en: I press my neck feathers to its and smooth them.

lines.zh: 它们站在同一块石头上
lines.en: They stand on the same stone.

lines.zh: 一只转身，另一只跟着转
lines.en: One turns; the other turns too.

lines.zh: 它们的动作几乎一模一样
lines.en: Their movements are nearly identical.
They look toward the cliff together.
One offers a fish to the other.

lines.zh: 它们靠得很近，几乎挨着
lines.en: They stand so close they almost touch.

lines.zh: 它们的呼吸在冷风里成雾
lines.en: Their breath fogs in the cold.
This ledge is just big enough for two.
The puffin snaps up the fish.
It arranges the fish crosswise.
It takes a second.
It turns toward its burrow.

lines.zh: 它对不是鱼的东西不理
lines.en: Anything but fish it ignores.
It sets the food by a crack.
It checks it over.
It lines the fish head at its throat.
After swallowing it licks its bill.
It heads back to the water.
The puffin straightens abruptly.
It opens its bill and calls.
It takes two steps toward you.

lines.zh: 我半张开翅膀，等你的手落下。
lines.en: I half-open my wings, waiting for your hand to drop.

lines.zh: 它把你认成了喂食的人
lines.en: It has taken you for a feeder.
It stares at your hands.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩台边缘绕到你侧面。
lines.en: I circle along the rock ledge to your flank.
Its feet slap the stone.
It stops and folds its wings.
It waits for you to offer something.
The puffin stays at your feet.
It shuffles wherever you go.
It looks up at your pocket.
It pecks your boot lightly.

lines.zh: 它在你鞋面上站了一会
lines.en: It stands on your shoe a while.
It cocks its head at your fingers.
It calls twice, urgently.
It goes round to your other side.
It is sure you have fish.
It simply will not leave.
The puffin pecks your ankle.
It clamps its bill on your trouser leg.
Its wings beat your shin.
It hits your shoe and rebounds.
It shakes its head and tugs.
It snaps air; the bill clacks.
It backs off and calls twice.
It charges again, stubborn.
Its feet skid on the stone.
It retreats to the cliff edge, watching.

lines.zh: 岩缝里钻出一个圆脑袋
lines.en: A round head pokes out of a crevice.
The puffin squeezes out of the crack.
It shakes off the grit.
It hones its bill on the rock.
It walks to the edge and looks out.
The wind lifts its breast feathers.
It turns and comes your way.

lines.zh: 它的脚掌在冰上留下一串印
lines.en: Its feet leave a line of prints on the ice.
It stops and flicks its short tail.
Then it looks straight at you.

lines.zh: 羽毛被燎到，它跳着躲开
lines.en: Singed, it hops away from the heat.
It tumbles twice on landing.

lines.zh: 在水里它扑腾得很吃力
lines.en: In the water its paddling turns laboured.
The blast throws it to the rock's edge.

lines.zh: 箭擦过它的翅膀，掉了羽
lines.en: An arrow grazes its wing and takes feathers.

lines.zh: 我嘴上的橙，是海鹦的记号。
lines.en: The orange on my bill marks me a puffin.

lines.zh: 饿得站不稳，它还在看海
lines.en: Starving, it still watches the sea.

lines.zh: 雷击让它僵住，羽都炸起
lines.en: Lightning locks it, feathers on end.

lines.zh: 虚空一拉，它拍翅往下坠
lines.en: The void pulls; it beats its wings and drops.
